OK-governor.statusNote: Open seat, Gov. Stitt is term-limited. Former state Sen. Mike Mazzei defeated Attorney General Gentner Drummond by 2,020 votes out of more than 371,000 cast in the Aug 25 Republican runoff; Drummond conceded. House Minority Leader Cyndi Munson won the Democratic nomination June 16. Independents Jerry Griffin, Robert Brooks and Orlando Lynn Bush are also on the November ballot.

OK-senate.statusNote: Open seat: Sen. Markwayne Mullin resigned in March 2026 after his confirmation as Homeland Security secretary; appointed Sen. Alan Armstrong is not running. Rep. Kevin Hern won the June 16 Republican primary with 67.6% and no runoff. N'Kiyla Jasmine Thomas defeated Jim Priest with 61% in the Aug 25 Democratic runoff. Independents Ron Meinhardt and Curtis Stinnett and Libertarian Sevier White are also on the November ballot; none of the three has documented policy positions we could find, so they appear by name only.

OK-house-1.statusNote: Open seat: Rep. Kevin Hern (R) is running for Senate instead of re-election. State Rep. Mark Tedford (R) is the Republican nominee after runoff opponent Jackson Lahmeyer withdrew June 17, 2026; Tulsa school board member John Croisant (D) won the Democratic primary outright June 16, 2026 (The Green Papers Oklahoma 2026 general candidate roster; NonDoc). Positions researched and stored, race not scored, overlap 0 of 10 as of Sep 2, 2026.

candidates.name: Gentner Drummond
candidates.background: Oklahoma Attorney General since 2023; former Air Force F-15 pilot who flew 32 combat missions in the Gulf War, Osage County rancher, banking lawyer, and principal owner of Blue Sky Bank. Led the June 16 primary with just over 25%, then lost the Aug 25 Republican runoff to Mike Mazzei by 2,020 votes and conceded.
priorities: Crack down on cartels and support law enforcement

cost.label: Would lower costs by confronting insurance companies and corporations rather than through broad tax cuts (News9 candidate guide)

immigration.label: 'Strong supporter of President Trump's border policies', tougher immigration enforcement and cooperation with federal authorities (News9 candidate guide)

taxes.label: 'Cut taxes responsibly without sacrificing schools, roads, or public safety', with property tax relief (campaign issues)

climate.label: Joined Republican AGs opposing the lesser prairie-chicken endangered listing and Biden administration changes to the 'waters of the United States' rule, and sued the EPA over ozone regulations (Wikipedia)

education.label: Education plan invests in public schools: reading proficiency by 3rd grade, CareerTech and apprenticeship expansion, incentivizing teachers (campaign issues)

safety.label: 'Crack down on cartel activity and drug trafficking' and 'support and strengthen local law enforcement' (campaign issues)

repro.label: As AG sued the Biden administration for suspending Oklahoma's Title X grant after the state declined to provide abortion referrals, defending the state's pro-life policies (Oklahoma AG press release)

democracy.label: In a DOJ voter-data settlement touted Oklahoma's proof-of-identity requirement, absentee ballot notarization, and ballot harvesting ban, pledging cooperation 'to eliminate voter fraud' (Oklahoma AG press release)
